zh.tagline: 转一下头就能截图，一只手搞定
zh.welcomeTitle: 第一次用，先校准一下（约 10 秒）
zh.welcomeBody: 屏幕上会依次出现 5 个红点，转头让鼻子对准，停住 1 秒就行。
zh.hotkeyHint: 按一下出框，再按一下确认。按 Esc 或其他键取消
zh.calibHint: 换了座位、显示器或摄像头，或者框出现的位置不准时
zh.deadzoneHint: 头偏不到这个角度，框完全不动。越大越稳
zh.speedHint: 头偏出不动区后，框挪动的快慢
zh.secBoxHint: （也可以直接拖右边框的四个角）
zh.autoPasteHint: 默认只放进剪贴板，你按 Ctrl+V 粘贴。打开后会自动帮你按一次粘贴
zh.showStickHint: 框中间的虚线区和小圆点，熟练以后可以关掉
zh.keepCameraHint: 出框更快，但摄像头指示灯会一直亮。默认用完 20 秒自动关
zh.privacy: 🔒 摄像头画面只在这台电脑上处理，不联网、不上传、不保存。
zh.quitHint: 右下角托盘图标右键可以随时退出。
zh.tryHint: 拖框的四个角改大小；点右边按钮，用转头移动框，边试边调左边的数值
zh.pill: 转头移动框 · {key} 确认 · Esc 取消
zh.pillCamFail: 摄像头打不开：请到设置里选一个摄像头，或者关掉正在用摄像头的软件
zh.calibStep: 校准 {i} / {n}：转头，让鼻子对准红点，然后停住眼睛看哪里无所谓，看的是头的方向 · 按 Esc 退出
zh.calibCamFail: 摄像头打不开<small>请到设置里换一个摄像头，或者关掉正在用摄像头的软件。按 Esc 退出</small>
zh.calibDone: 校准完成 ✓<small>以后按快捷键，框就会出现在你鼻子指的地方</small>
zh.faceLost: 没看到脸：脸对着摄像头，别背光

en.tagline: Turn your head to take a screenshot. One hand, no mouse.
en.welcomeBody: Five red dots appear one by one. Turn your head so your nose points at each dot and hold still for a second.
en.hotkeyHint: Press once to show the frame, again to capture. Esc or any other key cancels
en.calibHint: Redo it after moving your seat, or changing display or camera
en.deadzoneHint: Head turns smaller than this don't move the frame. Bigger = steadier
en.speedHint: How fast the frame moves once you leave the dead zone
en.secBoxHint: (or drag the corners on the right)
en.autoPasteHint: By default the shot goes to the clipboard and you press Ctrl+V. Turn on to paste automatically
en.showStickHint: The dashed zone and dot in the middle of the frame
en.keepCameraHint: Faster, but the camera light stays on. By default it turns off 20 s after use
en.privacy: 🔒 Camera frames are processed on this computer only. Nothing is uploaded or saved.
en.quitHint: Right-click the tray icon to quit at any time.
en.tryHint: Drag the corners to resize. Press the button and move the frame with your head while you tune the settings
en.pill: Turn your head to move · {key} capture · Esc cancel
en.pillCamFail: Can't open the camera. Pick another one in Settings, or close apps using it
en.calibStep: Calibration {i} / {n}: turn your head so your nose points at the red dot, then hold stillYour eyes can look anywhere; only head direction counts · Esc to quit
en.calibCamFail: Can't open the camera<small>Pick another one in Settings, or close apps using it. Esc to quit</small>
en.calibDone: Calibrated ✓<small>From now on the frame appears where your nose points</small>
en.faceLost: No face: face the camera, avoid backlight
